mechanism: Posaconazole is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase systemic timolol exposure through metabolism inhibition, though ophthalmic timolol has minimal systemic absorption.
action: Monitor for increased beta-blocker effects (bradycardia, hypotension) if significant systemic absorption occurs; ophthalmic route minimizes clinical risk but caution warranted in patients with cardiac comorbidities.
